transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for calling S-Net, I'm Adam. How can I help?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Hi. My contract ended in June, nobody told me, and I've been paying sixty pounds a month ever since instead of thirty. I'm really angry that you just let it run on like that.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you, Ines. So your contract ended in June, and since then you've been paying sixty pounds a month instead of thirty. Is that right?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, the end date was the fifteenth of June. I was on the Fibre 300 plan.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Okay. What plan were you on?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thanks. Did you receive any end-of-contract letter or email?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: And when did the contract end?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Okay. I can see the end-of-contract notice was sent to an old email address. I can put you on a new eighteen-month Fibre 300 deal at twenty-eight pounds a month, and refund the difference since June, ninety-six pounds.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Done. The new price starts today and the refund will be on your next bill. Can you check the confirmation email to make sure the new price is showing?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, it says twenty-eight pounds a month.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Great, so you're on the new deal and the refund is applied. Is there anything else?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for choosing S-Net, Ines.
